inbox.content: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) are on the brink of extinction as their essential Arctic sea ice habitat vanishes at alarming rates, twice the global average due to the climate crisis. This devastating ice loss drastically hampers their ability to hunt seals, putting their very survival in jeopardy. While some may tout stability in specific subpopulations, these claims often overlook the bears' critical reliance on ice and the harsh reality of increased fasting and reduced cub survival during extended ice-free periods, especially in southern regions. Monitoring efforts are inconsistent, clouding our understanding of their true plight. Furthermore, pressures from conservation hunting quotas and pollution only worsen their situation. Claims that polar bears are thriving or that climate change is a myth based on isolated increases in population are not only unfounded but dangerously misleading. We must confront the stark reality of climate change and its catastrophic effects on these iconic creatures and our ecosystems as a whole. #climateaction #wildlifeconservation
inbox.originalContent: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) depend on sea ice as a platform for hunting seals. Arctic sea ice has declined in extent and thickness over the satellite era as the Arctic has warmed about twice as fast as the global mean (Arctic amplification). The IUCN and Arctic scientists treat loss of sea-ice hunting habitat as the primary long-term threat to the species. Some subpopulations have been relatively stable or better counted in recent surveys, which deniers sometimes quote as 'polar bears are fine.' That snapshot does not cancel the physical dependence on ice or projections of increased fasting and reduced cub survival as ice-free seasons lengthen, especially in southern parts of the range. Polar-bear numbers are not a single global census with low error; management units differ. Conservation hunting quotas and pollution are additional pressures, but they do not make sea-ice loss irrelevant. There is no scientific basis for the claim that polar bears are thriving because of chemtrails or that global warming is a hoax because one subpopulation increased.
